resources.string: Live AI dubbing for every language
Play any video or podcast, then start live dubbing.
Live dubbing and document narration, powered by Gemini
Translate and dub audio from other apps in real time.
Listen to PDF or TXT documents with AI narration.
Paste key from Google AI Studio
Change the language of Voxora menus. This is separate from the dubbing language.
Get a free key at aistudio.google.com/apikey — then paste it here. Sign-in is optional and does not replace the API key.
Show a Live bubble with Stop while dubbing. Requires overlay permission.
No API key. Open Settings and paste your Gemini key.
Microphone or notification permission was denied.
Screen capture was cancelled. Try again when ready.
Invalid API key. Check the key in Settings.
Network error. Check connection and try again.
Could not start screen capture. Try again.
Gemini quota exceeded. Wait or use another API key.
Could not capture system audio. Try again.
Allow screen capture when asked — Voxora only uses system audio, not your camera.
Live dubbing has ~2–3s delay from the AI model — that is normal.
Hear any app in your language — powered by Gemini Live Translate.
Capture permission is required to hear system audio.
Play YouTube, podcasts, or any app. Voxora captures system audio and speaks a live translation in your language.
When Android asks to capture the screen, allow it. Voxora uses audio only — not your camera. You can stop anytime from the app or notification.
Create a key in Google AI Studio, paste it in Settings, pick a dubbing language, then press Start. Optional: sign in with Google to save your profile.
Optional. You can use Voxora without signing in — just paste a Gemini API key.
Sign-in failed. Try again or continue as guest.
Google Sign-In needs a Web client ID. Add it in strings (default_web_client_id) from Google Cloud Console, or continue as guest with an API key.
Status while live dubbing is active
Live dubbing in progress. Tap Stop to end.
Live dubbing in progress. Tap Stop to end.

Reader sends the current and next chunk to Gemini using your saved API key (shared with Live Dub). Gemini narrates the complete text in your selected language and style, translating when needed. Temporary audio is cached on this device. No phone text-to-speech or separate backend is used. PDFs need selectable text; scans require OCR.
Reader keeps playing in the background and with the screen off. Pause here or stop from the notification. Resume restarts the selected segment; Stop returns to the first chunk.
Background document narration and playback controls
Preparing or playing your document. Tap Stop Reader to end narration.
Could not start Reader playback. Keep the app open and try again.
Could not connect to Gemini. Check your connection and try again.
Gemini did not return audio for this chunk. Try again.
Could not connect to any supported Gemini narration model. Check your connection and key, then try again.
Audio output is unavailable. Close other media apps and try again.
Choose a PDF or TXT file to start listening.
Rewrites the source naturally for clearer listening while preserving the original meaning and information.
Stays as close as possible to the original book wording, changing only what is necessary to make extracted text readable and narratable.
Exactly the text extracted from your file. Tap a segment to start there.
Gemini\'s narration appears here while it speaks.
Narration stopped partway through this segment. Received audio has finished playing. Your position is kept; Play retries this segment from its beginning.
This segment could not be narrated. Your position is kept. Check your connection, key and model access, then press Play to retry.
Could not read this document. Choose an accessible UTF-8 TXT or unlocked, selectable-text PDF (up to 20 MB). Scanned PDFs need OCR.
This is the selected source segment. The highlight follows the audio actually played, not an estimated translation timeline.
The next segment remains visible and can be selected during playback.
